description: This file contains functions and classes for establishing and managing connections to a browser instance in the Playwright testing framework, including WebSocket and pipe transports, and connection lifecycle management.

classes.name: JsonPipeTransport
classes.description: Handles communication over a JSON pipe channel, implementing the Transport interface.

classes.name: WebSocketTransport
classes.description: Handles WebSocket communication, implementing the Transport interface.

methods.name: connectToBrowser
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a browser instance using provided parameters, returning a Browser object.

methods.name: connectToEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a connection to a specified endpoint, returning a Connection object.
